name: ⚓ Harbor Havoc
desc:
Welcome to Harbor Havoc, a Red vs Blue sea battle game. 

Fly military grade planes, command warships and man powerful turrets. Destroy the enemy harbor and bring your team to victory!

Battle the enemy team for land and power in this action-packed naval warfare game! 
🏝 Claim abandoned islands to quarter your team’s arsenal. 
⚓ Work with others to form fleets and take on the enemy together. 
🗺 Scout, plan, then BRING HAVOC TO THE HARBOR! 

Want to stay up to date on the latest news from Harbor Havoc? 
📶🔔 Follow the game for updates!
👥 Join the official Harbor Havoc group!
